about: One row per shipped AWS id: the sha256 of the payload that was reviewed against its caption, the verdict (ok or mismatch), who reviewed it and when. A row counts only while the artwork still has that hash. Regenerate the pages with: node skills/arkitect-drawio/scripts/contact-sheet.mjs --pack aws --review (#73).
